name: Pokes climb Boop's mood one step at a time
case: Boop is calm when the person pokes it once, twice and three times in a row, a second apart. Each poke moves its mood one step: first curious or happy, then annoyed, then irritated or grumpy, and never a move the mood graph doesn't have.
why: characters/boop/steering/mood/: a poke moves calm to curious or happy, two in a row to annoyed, three to irritated or grumpy (a jump a barrage earns); the mood question offers only the mood's moves
